Pair WhatsApp

Link a WhatsApp account to this server

How to pair
  1. Enter your dedicated WhatsApp number above
  2. Click "Request Pairing Code"
  3. Open WhatsApp → Settings → Linked Devices → Link a Device
  4. Tap "Link with phone number instead"
  5. Enter the 8-character code shown
